question: Incremental PVR score reordering against original H1 within same-date/same-sector comparable legal I opportunities. Not PVR>50 gate, amount-only increment, CP1 or global portfolio.
universe: All32899 original legal I candidate snapshots; not economic-risk subsets filtered PVR>50 or unconfirmed CP1, not chosen among seen193 outcomes. Reuse raw/cache fields only; known development history.
features: Same experiment-two continuous I source epoch, first original Q anchor, age in actual observed valid-price bars after anchor, cumulative causal log price runup; re-created for ALL original I legal candidates. Current causal E0 visible epoch unique. No future end/confirmation date in ID.
matching: Within chronological day/sector create all admissible unordered pairs. Sort H1 distance, age difference, normalized runup difference, hash of then-known fields. Greedily consume each E0 event at most once across roles/dates. PVR values and future returns never select pairs. Missing PVR/scale not imputed.
classification: After pairing reveal strict PVR rank rounded12. Agreement means same stock/no change. Exact PVR tie gives no rank contrast and retain H1. Conflict compares higher PVR against original H1 choice, whose ties use original symbol ID. H1 ties separately reported.
weights: Equal frozen conflict pairs primary, same set across costs/fill/closure. Report mean incremental effect across ALL comparable matched pairs as sum conflict deltas/total matched (agreement/tie policy difference0). Unmatched never get zero return or enter this denominator.
execution: Each alternative fresh1m at same decision close, native next-open/daylease/raw gap guard/whole lots/T+1/actual fees; original I/E0 exit, no F/CP/ACT/add/reentry or compounding. Hold cash after exit until commonOct27 2026.
terminal: No-fill/open shares/pending rights all retained. Marks separate from execution, liquidation estimate only memo.
tail: Pair-tail either actual post-decision net_return>=.30, terminal versus realized separate; continuous contribution curve. All failures and fees. Win rate not a pass gate.
coverage_gate: Publish comparable/conflict/tie/agreement/unmatched coverage and H1/age/runup/scale/PVR balance before outcomes. No conflict or insufficient comparable support means unidentified/inconclusive, never relax calipers or pick other dates.
verdict: Positive relative and absolute contribution with cost stability and tail preservation supports only local reordering. Mixed effects tradeoff. Cost reversal/poor coverage/residual imbalance inconclusive. No causal or general score monotonicity claim.
checks: Causal IDs, E0 uniqueness, PVR-neutral pair-selection invariant, three temporal matching prefixes, six chronological conflict-pair samples and native cash/fees/shares/terminal, physical economic prefix, sample/full exact.
